limitations: Pure supplied dict/JSON-bytes consistency only; no filesystem, process, Docker, network, persistence or authorization operations.
Standalone replay does not establish relationship to disk. Optional predecessor checks one canonical append, not signature, durable receipt, provenance or actual intent-before-effect ordering.

Local-volume create can reuse an existing name; no immutable volume ID or freshness proof is available. Continuity remains explicitly unverified. Live backing-directory/mount identity and restart reconciliation are unimplemented.
Bounded diagnostics preserve prior facts and close normal progression; this unwired consistency rule adds no emergency recovery or stop-authorization gate.
Inspection/configuration hashes do not prove their contents or image inheritance, actual mount/network safety, source provenance or seed installation.
Collision checks cover represented auxiliary container/network identities only; independently observed working resource identities remain outside this module.
Lab allocation/console, operator replacement scope, physical/material/runtime admission, secure materialization/persistence, context-aware lifecycle and full recovery harness remain pending.
Global release/lint, H7/W16, Coordinator and private-backup requirements remain unwaived. No candidate deployment or new image scan is claimed.
